headline: Public Baike HTML answered 0 of 8 watched articles
dek: Topic and event pages are fetched without a login. A 403 or login wall is recorded as unreachable, never as a rewrite. The Wikipedia-fork collector stays disabled.

claims.statement: The public Baike snapshot fetched 0 of 8 watched articles this round.

method.summary: Keyless GET of reviewed public Baike article URLs; extract_baike facets; hash comparison against node-local state; CDX digest attached when IA answers.

limitations: A refused fetch is evidence about this vantage reaching Baike, not a count of encyclopedia rewrites.
